LESSON: READING ALOUD: FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.1: Reading Aloud: Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud: Fluency, part of Reading in Grade 7 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: Why is fluency important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. differentiate words and phrases based on their pronunciation correctly,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading Aloud: Fluency in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. read simple sentences on basic introductions fluently,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading Aloud: Fluency in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. develop an interest in reading Arabic texts for enjoyment.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading Aloud: Fluency in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. differentiate words and phrases based on their pronunciation correctly,

   Reading Aloud: Fluency helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. read simple sentences on basic introductions fluently,

   Reading Aloud: Fluency helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. develop an interest in reading Arabic texts for enjoyment.

   Reading Aloud: Fluency helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read words and phrases while underlining huruf shamsiyya and huruf qamariyyah from a given display,

2. read short sentences on greetings and introductions fluently,

3. use think-pair-share to read and complete simple sentences,

4. practise reading from a variety of texts at home.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read words and phrases while underlining huruf shamsiyya and huruf qamariyyah from a given display,
2. read short sentences on greetings and introductions fluently,
3. use think-pair-share to read and complete simple sentences,
4. practise reading from a variety of texts at home.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud: Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: self-awareness Skills are enhanced as the learner practises reading from variety of texts at home.

• Communication and collaboration: Teamwork skills are enhanced during the think-pair-share activity to read and complete

simple sentences in groups.

Values:
Unity: This is nurtured as the learner strives to achieve a common goal in doing given tasks.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Nationalism: This is promoted as the learner appreciates basic greetings and introductions and applies them to ignite social

relations with people in the society.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept on greetings and introduction to their learning of polite language in English and Kiswahili.
